UNSPECIFIED.description: The source does not distinguish the assertion's role.

MEMBERSHIP.description: The object belongs to the named constellation or curated group.

OPERATOR.description: The source identifies the constellation's operator or owner.

OBJECT_IDENTITY.description: The source establishes the NORAD catalogue identity or object join.

BUS_IDENTITY.description: The source establishes the object's satellite-bus join.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source does not state whether the membership is current.

ACTIVE.description: The object is a current member of the constellation.

FORMER.description: The object was formerly a member and is retained for history.

CMRProvenance.description:
Replayable provenance for one fact used by a $CMR.

Each source gets its own entry. A publisher never merges a catalogue's
group membership, a reference catalogue's ownership assertion, and
$CAT/$BUS joins into one ambiguous citation.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source does not distinguish the assertion's role.

MEMBERSHIP.description: The object belongs to the named constellation or curated group.

OPERATOR.description: The source identifies the constellation's operator or owner.

OBJECT_IDENTITY.description: The source establishes the NORAD catalogue identity or object join.

BUS_IDENTITY.description: The source establishes the object's satellite-bus join.

SOURCE.description:
Publisher name verbatim as that publisher states it — a public satellite
catalogue, a general object reference catalogue, or the network provider
that published the joined $CAT record.

SOURCE_DATASET.description:
Source dataset or product name verbatim, such as a named constellation
group file or a catalogue's satellite-catalog product.

SOURCE_RECORD_ID.description: Source-native row, group, object, or catalogue identifier.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL or provider query identifying the source material.

SOURCE_VERSION.description: Source revision, edition, or upstream update marker verbatim.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact source payload bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal
characters. Empty only when the source cannot expose replayable bytes.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Empty means unknown terms, never public
domain and never an implied grant.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text required by the source.

NOTES.description: Source caveats or reconciliation notes; never a substitute for a field.

CMR.description:
Constellation Membership Record.

One record asserts that one NORAD-catalogued object belongs (or formerly
belonged) to one named constellation. Record sets are therefore directly
keyable and queryable by NORAD_CAT_ID in FlatSQL. The record joins to $CAT
by NORAD_CAT_ID and OBJECT_ID and may join through $CAT.BUS_ID to $BUS; it
does not duplicate catalogue or bus properties.

CONSTELLATION_ID and OPERATOR_ID are publisher-stable identifiers. Display
names and aliases are carried separately so consumers never use branding as
identity. Every emitted record names the independent source assertions used
to establish membership, operator, and catalogue joins.

MEMBERSHIP_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this assertion, unique within its record
set. Recommended form: "<constellation-id>:<norad-cat-id>".

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: NORAD catalogue number. Zero is invalid for a published record.

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator copied verbatim from the joined $CAT when known.

CONSTELLATION_ID.description: Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the constellation/group.

CONSTELLATION_NAME.description:
Human-readable constellation name as published by the authoritative
membership source.

CONSTELLATION_ALIASES.description:
Alternate constellation names, brands, and search terms. Values are
verbatim; consumers must not treat aliases as stable identifiers.

OPERATOR_ID.description:
Publisher-stable operator/owner identifier. Empty when no source supports
one; never synthesized from a display name.

OPERATOR_NAME.description: Operator/owner display name verbatim from the cited source.

OPERATOR_ALIASES.description: Alternate operator names and brands, verbatim.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source does not state whether the membership is current.

ACTIVE.description: The object is a current member of the constellation.

FORMER.description: The object was formerly a member and is retained for history.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant at which this reconciled assertion
was emitted.

PROVENANCE.description:
Independent evidence used to construct this assertion. At least one
MEMBERSHIP entry is required by the publishing contract.
